description: This file implements a server handling WebSocket and HTTP connections using Boost.Asio and Boost.Beast, including SSL detection, session management, and request handling for the Kuksa project.

classes.name: ConnectionHandler
classes.description: Helper class managing active WebSocket and HTTP sessions, adding and removing clients, and tracking connection info.

classes.name: WebSocketSession
classes.description: Template base class for WebSocket sessions handling accept, read, write, and control frames.

classes.name: PlainWebsocketSession
classes.description: Handles a plain WebSocket connection, including upgrade, message exchange, and timeout.

classes.name: SslWebsocketSession
classes.description: Handles an SSL WebSocket connection, including SSL handshake, shutdown, and timeout.

classes.name: HttpSession
classes.description: Template base class for HTTP sessions managing request reading, response writing, and WebSocket upgrade detection.

classes.name: PlainHttpSession
classes.description: Handles a plain HTTP connection, including request parsing and shutdown.

classes.name: SslHttpSession
classes.description: Handles an SSL HTTP connection, including SSL handshake, shutdown, and request processing.

classes.name: DetectSession
classes.description: Detects whether incoming connection is SSL or plain and launches appropriate session.

classes.name: BeastListener
classes.description: Accepts incoming TCP connections and launches DetectSession for SSL detection.

methods.name: WebSockHttpFlexServer::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes server with host, port, certificate path, and SSL settings, loads certificates, and sets up listener.

methods.name: WebSockHttpFlexServer::HandleRequest
methods.description: Processes incoming JSON requests, dispatches to registered command processors, and returns response.

methods.name: WebSockHttpFlexServer::AddListener
methods.description: Registers a new command processor listener for specific observer types.

methods.name: WebSockHttpFlexServer::RemoveListener
methods.description: Removes a registered command processor listener.

methods.name: WebSockHttpFlexServer::LoadCertData
methods.description: Loads SSL certificate and key files from specified path into SSL context.

methods.name: WebSockHttpFlexServer::SendToConnection
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific connection identified by ConnectionId, if active.

methods.name: WebSockHttpFlexServer::Start
methods.description: Starts the server, begins listening for connections, and runs I/O threads.
